text:
ashley: quick sync on admission design. we saw tenant-level bursts where parallel proxies each pulled from local caches and the tenant quota was exceeded for ~700ms. want a robust pattern that keeps p99 low but prevents aggregate overspend.

dmitri: reproduced in staging. root cause: independent local caches w/o centralized accounting for short bursts.

kevin: two candidate patterns: 1) tighten local cache TTL to near-zero (latency win lost) 2) introduce small 'bucketed admission' tokens per-proxy granted by central. buckets are soft leases that expire quickly.

maria: prefer bucketed admission. it buys us headroom for p99 without risking large overspend if we bound bucket size and have emergency fast-decline.

zoe: propose policy table: free-tier: no emergency buffer, minimal bucket (2-5 tokens); standard: small bucket (10 tokens); enterprise: larger bucket + emergency buffer (20 tokens). buckets granted with lease_ms and idempotency token.

kevin: API sketch (http/proto) — POST /quota/v1/buckets/grant {tenant, proxy, requested, idempotency} => {granted, lease_ms}. proxies consume locally until grant drained. when lease expires, proxies must re-grant or fallback to sync check.

dmitri: safety hooks: central computes sum(granted) across proxies and compares against central_spent. if aggregate_delta > threshold for window, central issues 'fast-decline' for tenant (granted=0) and notifies proxies to disable local buckets for N seconds. also persist per-proxy grant ledger for later reconciliation.

maria: telemetry: bucket_granted_total, bucket_spent_total, grant_reconcile_delta. alerting rules: delta > 5% over 2s OR >2% over 30s. dashboard + replay tool to inspect per-tenant deltas.

zoe: rollout plan: shadow mode (proxies report decisions but don't act) for 7 days -> small bucket enabled for 5% of tenants -> monitor reconcile delta -> increase gradually. include kill-switch to force central-only admissions.

ashley: security & abuse notes: grant API requires mTLS + proxy identity + per-proxy rate-limits; include idempotency key and sequence number to avoid double-grant on retries. also throttle grant requests per-tenant to avoid refill amplification attempts.

kevin: edge-case: network partition. proxies should have an 'emergency' budget policy that depends on tenant tier. default is deny (429) for low tiers; enterprise gets short emergency allowance with clear logging for billing reconciliation.

maria: agree. ensure billing reconciler can attribute local spends and central spends to avoid surprises. persist events to ledger with timestamps and proxy_id.

rachel-bot: infra-note: canary window open 2025-07-08 15:00 UTC; canary cluster has 6 proxies.

ashley: action items: kevin -> RFC + proto (5d); maria -> telemetry & dashboard (6d); dmitri -> security checklist + rate-limits (3d); zoe -> tier policy table + emergency budgets (3d); lee/ops -> coordinate canary (ops owners). will assemble RFC after kevin's draft. objections? :thumbsup:

kevin: starting the draft now, will include examples and idempotency semantics. ping if you want to pair.

maria: I'll wire up initial queries and a grafana panel for reconcile_delta.

ashley: thanks all, closing here until RFC is up.
